title: Cost an electric bus over its life
heading: Lifecycle Cost Is Every Cost of Owning the Asset, Discounted to One Date
cases: at a zero rate the lifecycle cost is the price, every year's running cost, the one-off costs, less the resale value
the first year's running cost is discounted one year, and the last is paid at the end of the life
a battery replacement in year six of the life is discounted six years
the resale value received at the end of the life reduces the cost by its present value, not its face value
